raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

HiCache's `file` storage backend (like the other flat-page L3 backends) moves one page between the host pool and storage through `get_data_page` / `get_dummy_flat_data_page` / `set_from_flat_data_page`. For models with `head_dim != v_head_dim` (e.g. MiMo-V2, K 192 / V 128) `AsymmetricMHATokenToKVPoolHost` raises `NotImplementedError` in all three. There is no start-up guard and backups/prefetches catch the exception, so with `--hicache-storage-backend file` the L3 tier silently stores nothing and the log fills with tracebacks. The error message also names hf3fs/eic/nixl only, although `file` takes the same path.

## Modifications

- `AsymmetricMHATokenToKVPoolHost`: a flat page is K of the page flattened, followed by V of the page flattened. Since K and V live in two buffers with different head dims, `get_data_page` returns a copy (`torch.cat`); `set_from_flat_data_page` splits it back and rejects a page of the wrong size. Supported for the two layouts the class already supports (`page_first`, `page_first_direct`); `flat=False` still raises.
- `_flat_page_unsupported` message updated (now only for `flat=False`).
- New CPU test `test/registered/hicache/test_asymmetric_mha_flat_page.py`: round-trips pages through the real `HiCacheFile` backend for both layouts, restoring into different slots, bit-exact; plus wrong-size and `flat=False` rejection. It fails on current main (3 failed) and passes with this change.

## Accuracy Tests

Does not change model forward code. Run in production-like conditions on our side with the same patch on `lmsysorg/sglang:dev` (nightly 684fea8a), MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD, TP4 on 4× B300, `--enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-storage-backend file` (hybrid SWA pool, DFlash draft pool):
- prompts of 56k / 250k / 800k tokens restored from disk after an 8M-token flood evicted them from GPU and host memory; answers identical to a cold run (temperature 0, text and token count), 0 tracebacks;
- reasoning benchmarks on the same deployment (AIME 2025+2026, GPQA Diamond, MMLU-Pro, LiveCodeBench, IFEval, HLE-Verified Gold, ARC-AGI-2, …) over ~14 h with the disk tier on: no errors attributable to the cache.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not a hot path for models that do not use the file backend. With it, restore times on the setup above (cold / host RAM / disk, seconds): 56k 4.13 / 0.47 / 2.2; 250k 10.7 / 0.56 / 6.1–7.1; 800k 55.8 / 1.37 / 19.5–19.9.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (isort 7.0.0, ruff 0.15.1 / ruff-format as pinned)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (no user-facing option changes)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Related: #29013 (MiMo + HiCache with Mooncake; a different code path).

@@ -1326,9 +1326,8 @@ def _v_layout_dim(self) -> int:
 
     def _flat_page_unsupported(self) -> NotImplementedError:
         return NotImplementedError(
-            "Models with head_dim != v_head_dim do not support the flat-page "
-            "interface used by HiCache L3 storage backends {hf3fs, eic, nixl}. "
-            "Use a backend that does not use this interface (e.g. mooncake, simm)."
+            "Models with head_dim != v_head_dim only support flat pages "
+            "(get_data_page(flat=True)): K and V live in separate buffers."
         )
 
     def load_to_device_per_layer(
@@ -1479,14 +1478,55 @@ def backup_from_device_all_layer(
                 f"{io_backend}; expected 'kernel' or 'direct'."
             )
 
+    # Flat page = K of the page flattened, followed by V of the page flattened.
+    # K and V live in two buffers with different head dims, so a page cannot be
+    # a single view; get_data_page returns a copy (torch.cat).
+
+    def _page_slices(self, index: int):
+        if self.layout == "page_first":
+            return (
+                self.k_buffer[index : index + self.page_size],
+                self.v_buffer[index : index + self.page_size],
+            )
+        if self.layout == "page_first_direct":
+            real_index = index // self.page_size
+            return (
+                self.k_buffer[real_index : real_index + 1],
+                self.v_buffer[real_index : real_index + 1],
+            )
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Unsupported layout for models with head_dim != v_head_dim: {self.layout}"
+        )
+
+    def _flat_page_numels(self):
+        per_token = self.layer_num * self.head_num * self.page_size
+        return per_token * self.head_dim, per_token * self.v_head_dim
+
     def get_data_page(self, index, flat: bool = True) -> torch.Tensor:
-        raise self._flat_page_unsupported()
+        if not flat:
+            raise self._flat_page_unsupported()
+        k, v = self._page_slices(index)
+        return torch.cat([k.reshape(-1), v.reshape(-1)])
 
     def get_dummy_flat_data_page(self) -> torch.Tensor:
-        raise self._flat_page_unsupported()
+        k_numel, v_numel = self._flat_page_numels()
+        return torch.zeros(
+            k_numel + v_numel,
+            dtype=self.dtype,
+            device=self.device,
+            pin_memory=self.pin_memory,
+        )
 
     def set_from_flat_data_page(self, index: int, data_page: torch.Tensor) -> None:
-        raise self._flat_page_unsupported()
+        k_numel, v_numel = self._flat_page_numels()
+        if data_page.numel() != k_numel + v_numel:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"Flat page has {data_page.numel()} elements, expected "
+                f"{k_numel + v_numel} (K {k_numel} + V {v_numel})"
+            )
+        k, v = self._page_slices(index)
+        k.copy_(data_page[:k_numel].reshape(k.shape))
+        v.copy_(data_page[k_numel:].reshape(v.shape))
 
     def get_split_heads_page_buffer_meta(
         self, indices: torch.Tensor, split_factor: int

@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+"""Flat-page round trip for AsymmetricMHATokenToKVPoolHost (head_dim != v_head_dim).
+
+HiCache's `file` storage backend (and the other flat-page backends) moves one page
+between the host pool and storage through get_data_page / get_dummy_flat_data_page /
+set_from_flat_data_page. These used to raise NotImplementedError for asymmetric
+K/V models (e.g. MiMo-V2: K 192 / V 128), so the L3 tier silently did nothing.
+
+CPU-only: builds the host pool buffers directly and round-trips pages through the
+real HiCacheFile backend, bit-exact, for both supported layouts.
+"""
+
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.hicache_storage import HiCacheFile, HiCacheStorageConfig
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.mha import AsymmetricMHATokenToKVPoolHost
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+PAGE_SIZE, LAYERS, HEADS, K_DIM, V_DIM, PAGES = 16, 3, 2, 192, 128, 4
+
+
+def _host_pool(layout: str, fill: bool) -> AsymmetricMHATokenToKVPoolHost:
+    # Bypass __init__ (it needs a device pool and pinned memory); set only what
+    # the flat-page methods read.
+    pool = AsymmetricMHATokenToKVPoolHost.__new__(AsymmetricMHATokenToKVPoolHost)
+    pool.layout, pool.page_size = layout, PAGE_SIZE
+    pool.layer_num, pool.head_num = LAYERS, HEADS
+    pool.head_dim, pool.v_head_dim = K_DIM, V_DIM
+    pool.dtype, pool.device, pool.pin_memory = torch.bfloat16, "cpu", False
+    if layout == "page_first":
+        k_shape = (PAGES * PAGE_SIZE, LAYERS, HEADS, K_DIM)
+        v_shape = (PAGES * PAGE_SIZE, LAYERS, HEADS, V_DIM)
+    else:  # page_first_direct
+        k_shape = (PAGES, LAYERS, PAGE_SIZE, HEADS, K_DIM)
+        v_shape = (PAGES, LAYERS, PAGE_SIZE, HEADS, V_DIM)
+    make = (
+        (lambda s: torch.randn(s).to(torch.bfloat16))
+        if fill
+        else (lambda s: torch.zeros(s, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+    )
+    pool.kv_buffer = (make(k_shape), make(v_shape))
+    return pool
+
+
+class TestAsymmetricMHAFlatPage(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_round_trip_through_file_backend(self):
+        storage_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+        config = HiCacheStorageConfig(
+            tp_rank=0,
+            tp_size=1,
+            pp_rank=0,
+            pp_size=1,
+            attn_cp_rank=0,
+            attn_cp_size=1,
+            is_mla_model=False,
+            enable_storage_metrics=False,
+            is_page_first_layout=True,
+            model_name="test",
+            extra_config={"file_storage_path": storage_dir},
+        )
+        storage = HiCacheFile(config)
+        flat_numel = PAGE_SIZE * LAYERS * HEADS * (K_DIM + V_DIM)
+        for layout in ("page_first", "page_first_direct"):
+            with self.subTest(layout=layout):
+                src, dst = _host_pool(layout, True), _host_pool(layout, False)
+                for page in range(PAGES):
+                    flat = src.get_data_page(page * PAGE_SIZE, flat=True)
+                    self.assertEqual(flat.numel(), flat_numel)
+                    self.assertTrue(storage.set(f"{layout}-{page}", flat))
+                for page in range(PAGES):
+                    dst_page = PAGES - 1 - page  # restore into another slot
+                    buf = dst.get_dummy_flat_data_page()
+                    self.assertEqual(buf.numel(), flat_numel)
+                    self.assertIsNotNone(storage.get(f"{layout}-{page}", buf))
+                    dst.set_from_flat_data_page(dst_page * PAGE_SIZE, buf)
+                    src_k, src_v = src._page_slices(page * PAGE_SIZE)
+                    dst_k, dst_v = dst._page_slices(dst_page * PAGE_SIZE)
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(src_k, dst_k))
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(src_v, dst_v))
+
+    def test_wrong_size_page_is_rejected(self):
+        pool = _host_pool("page_first", False)
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            pool.set_from_flat_data_page(0, torch.zeros(5, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+
+    def test_non_flat_page_is_rejected(self):
+        pool = _host_pool("page_first", True)
+        with self.assertRaises(NotImplementedError):
+            pool.get_data_page(0, flat=False)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
